invariant.portable_principle: Surface substantial lexical or near-lexical clone evidence with reliable source ranges and enclosing symbols, without converting lexical similarity into a refactoring-safety claim.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: The pre-existing Python jscpd-collapse reference path now uses the standard-library AST directly to resolve enclosing Python symbols and no longer imports the repository adapter registry.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: Pinned jscpd finds lexical clones in a staged eligible .ts/.tsx input; a family-local lexical span mapper retains only pairs whose complete ranges lie within one proven function declaration or block-bodied arrow symbol, preserving distinct occurrences and joining only overlapping occurrences.
explicit_non_goals: Type checking, TypeScript Compiler API facts, import resolution, or call graphs
Class-method, decorator, namespace, or arbitrary expression-symbol mapping when the lexical mapper cannot prove the span
React, Node, framework, overload-compatibility, or codemod claims

reference_repairs: Removed the Python collapse script's repository-level scripts/_lib language-adapter import and froze the reference oracle with a positive pair, a behaviorally different clean file, stable JSON, and a no-AST-findings input.
Changed TypeScript triage rendering so a lexical finding explicitly says that semantic equivalence and refactor safety are unknown and does not route directly to an execution command.
Added output-local jscpd staging so generated/test/declaration/vendor files are excluded before the external detector sees them, then rechecked the same boundary while collapsing raw reports.
Dropped overload-signature pairs and any pair without a reliable enclosing symbol instead of inventing a module-level name.

Validated jscpd's statistics, duplicates list, and duplicate file/range records before marking the wrapper output completed; malformed zero-exit output is now a status-3 failure with no usable report.

Required each clone range endpoint to fit one symbol and retained occurrence ranges when clustering, preventing a cross-symbol span or independent repeated blocks in one symbol from being merged into a misleading finding.

syntax: line/block comments and quoted/template strings are masked before lexical mapping
function declarations, overload signatures, and block-bodied arrow declarations
type_system: Typed parameters and return annotations are treated as text for jscpd tokenization.
No type relation, overload compatibility, assignability, or generic fact is inferred.
module_resolution: None; source paths are only normalized against the explicit project root.
runtime: Python 3.11+ standard library for the installed scripts
Node/npm with an explicitly pre-populated npm cache containing jscpd@4.0.5
TypeScript 5.9.3 from the same explicit cache for fixture typecheck evidence

tooling.selected: Family-local jscpd@4.0.5 invoked by stock npx --offline, followed by a family-local TypeScript lexical span-to-symbol mapper.

rejected_alternatives.typescript_compiler_api: The accepted result is lexical cloning, not type or resolved-symbol facts; adding a Program/TypeChecker would expand this one-skill dependency surface without improving the claimed outcome.
rejected_alternatives.tree_sitter_or_ts_morph: Would add a parser/runtime dependency without replacing jscpd's lexical near-clone detector or earning a semantic claim.
rejected_alternatives.handwritten_duplicate_detector: Would duplicate mature token-clone behavior while being less trustworthy about thresholding.
rejected_alternatives.runtime_network_fallback: Would make an audit depend on registry availability and violate the copied-install offline contract.
rejected_alternatives.shared_typescript_parser_platform: No second accepted consumer has demonstrated this exact lexical span-mapping contract.

known_false_positives: jscpd can detect intentional repeated generated/test/declaration text if it receives it; staging and defensive collapse filtering exclude those categories.
Overload signatures are structurally repetitive but are not implementation clones, so they are dropped.
known_false_negatives: Any clone whose range cannot be enclosed in a function declaration or block-bodied arrow is deliberately omitted.
Class methods, decorators, namespaces, expression-bodied arrows, and unusual syntax may be omitted until a separately scoped parser contract earns support.
Lexically divergent semantic duplicates are outside this v1.
legitimate_similar_shapes: The typed behaviorally different functions remain clean because they contain no substantial repeated lexical fragment.
TSX is eligible source but no React/component semantics are inferred.

java_or_kotlin.idiomatic_representation: methods, overloads, generated sources, and annotation-processor output

agent_confusions: A source-checkout jscpd wrapper made the old Python skill look installed when it depended on repository scripts.
npm's ordinary npx behavior fetches by default, so an explicit cache preflight is necessary to keep audit execution deterministic/offline.
A raw jscpd pair can start above a function body, so reporting a guessed symbol would falsely imply precise ownership.
repeated_work: The raw tool output has to be staged/rebased and then collapsed into user-facing spans; this is intentional family-local evidence handling, not a reusable executor.
user_experience.smallest_later_improvement: Have the serial router/catalog integration expose the exact offline cache preflight and four-command copied-skill invocation, then measure whether one wrapper command is worth adding.

residual_risks: The host must deliberately provision a cache before the offline scan; this is an external Node/npm prerequisite.
The lexical span mapper favors omitted candidates over guessed symbols and therefore under-reports valid clone shapes.
jscpd result formats are pinned by version but must be revalidated when the version changes.
The fresh forward replay reused an agent that had unrelated explain-code task context because a new agent slot was unavailable; it received no find-duplication diagnosis or expected result.

next_decision.recommendation: Accept this as a TypeScript lexical-duplication pilot only after the independent adversarial review confirms the copied artifacts; do not extract shared TypeScript infrastructure yet.
next_decision.rationale: The user-visible final triage now proves the narrow outcome with an honest false-negative boundary and a selected-skill offline closure, while semantic analysis would be a separate capability.
